name: NUSC 3410
title: Physiology and Assessment of Nutritional Biomarkers
description: A lecture and laboratory course which provides advanced nutrition students with a foundational understanding of the physiological pathways underlying biomarkers used to characterize nutritional status, in addition to hands-on experience in the application of nutritional assessment methodology. Anthropometric, biochemical, clinical, dietary, and genetic assessments of healthy and clinical populations will be used to assess nutritional status.
